description: This script manages network QoS configurations, including loading network functions, handling kernel modules, parsing network rules, configuring interfaces, and managing firewall rules with iptables/ip6tables for QoS enforcement.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Adds a kernel module with appropriate insmod or modprobe, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds network interface name for a given interface, or reports error if not found.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables rules based on matching criteria, including protocol, ports, hosts, and other options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Handles configuration options for network interfaces and rule classification.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries, setting up interfaces and class groups.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns class numbers to QoS classes.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Sets class variable values based on configuration.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and configures a network interface for QoS, including traffic shaping and class setup.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts all configured network interfaces for QoS.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for QoS classification and marking.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts a QoS class group, setting up iptables chains and rules.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes firewall rules for QoS management.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains.
